subject: Request: pilot credits & short trial extension for Andes Ethnolinguistics field study
messages:
From: Dr. Lina Mendez <lina.mendez@andesuniv.edu>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Nov 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot credits & short trial extension for Andes Ethnolinguistics field study

Hi Sofia,

I'm Lina Mendez, Associate Professor at Andes University; we run a small ethnolinguistics lab that documents under-resourced Andean languages. We're planning a field season in January that needs lightweight, offline-capable ASR+OCR + lightweight summarization to preprocess recordings for annotators.

We evaluated Redwood during the 14-day trial and it's been very promising, but the trial expired mid-analysis and we need a short extension and some promotional credits to complete the pilot. Our work is non-commercial — funded by a regional research grant — and we have an IRB approval that allows us to pilot on de-identified transcripts.

Could Redwood provide:
- A one-month trial extension (additional 30 days), and
- $2,000 in usage credits (or equivalent) to finish preprocessing ~400 hours of low-SNR field recordings (we expect heavy token volume).

Attachments: field-study-protocol.pdf, IRB-approval-stub.pdf, budget-breakdown.xlsx

If useful, I'm available for a 30-min call next week to walk through the workflow and the data privacy plan. Our timeline is tight — we need the extension in place by Nov 10 to plan compute for January.

Thanks,

Lina Mendez
Associate Professor, Andes University
Andes Ethnolinguistics Lab
pilot@andeslab.org
+51 9 1234 5678

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Lina Mendez <lina.mendez@andesuniv.edu>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Nov 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits & short trial extension for Andes Ethnolinguistics field study

Hi Lina — thanks for the details and the attachments, really interesting work.

Quick answers up front: we can usually accommodate short trial extensions + research credits for non-commercial academic pilots. I need to confirm two bits with our internal approvals team:
1) confirmation of the IRB / de-identification process (we'll need a copy of the IRB letter or signed confirmation), and
2) the expected token profile / peak concurrency so we can size an appropriate quota and avoid throttling during preprocessing.

Ben — looping you in for credits/quota. Can you confirm if $2,000 is feasible under our academic promo budget for a one-off? If not, can you propose an alternate split (e.g., credits + discounted overage)?

I'll also run the IRB stub past our security folks but it looks reasonable at first glance. Lina — can you confirm the IRB file you attached is the signed approval (or point me to the official doc)?

If helpful, we can do a call Monday (Nov 3) morning PT.

Best,
Sofia
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Lina Mendez <lina.mendez@andesuniv.edu>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits & short trial extension for Andes Ethnolinguistics field study

Sofia — thanks for the intro. Lina — great to meet you over email.

Summary of internal thinking: our academic promo fund can typically support between $1,000–$3,000 for a one-time pilot, provided we document the research use and collect a short case study on outcomes. $2,000 is within range but I need a quick approval from Marcus for any grant above $1,500.

Marcus — could you approve a $2,000 promo credit for Andes University? Quick notes: non-commercial, IRB present (attached in thread), expected one-month extension. They requested extension by Nov 10 to plan January. If you'd prefer we offer $1,500 + 20% off overage, call it out and I'll invoice appropriately.

Technical note for Sophia/Ben: their workload will be token-heavy but mostly batch preprocessing (low concurrency). We could set a pre-configured quota and temporary rate limit to protect infra.

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Academic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: internal_promo_guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 14:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits & short trial extension for Andes Ethnolinguistics field study

Approve $2,000 in promo credits.

Two asks before we provision:
1) Formal one-page pilot acceptance stating: project name, PI (Lina Mendez), data de-identification assurance, desired start/end dates for the extension, and contact for follow-up. Sofia — can you capture this in an email reply and have Lina confirm?
2) If they request dedicated capacity or SLA we escalate; this is a straight hosted trial extension and credits.

Once Sofia confirms the acceptance email and Lina replies, Ben — please create the promo code and provisioning ticket with quotas.

Marcus
VP, Partnerships Operations
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Dr. Lina Mendez <lina.mendez@andesuniv.edu>

Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits & short trial extension for Andes Ethnolinguistics field study

Hello Sofia, Ben, Marcus — thank you so much for the quick responses and for considering our request. Below is the one-page acceptance summary you asked for. Please confirm and we'll sign electronically.

Project: Andean Minority Languages Preprocessing Pilot
PI: Dr. Lina Mendez, Andes University, Ethnolinguistics Lab
Scope: Preprocess ~400 hours of audio (de-identified) for ASR/OCR + summarization to create training-ready transcripts for annotators. No commercial redistribution; outputs used for internal research and published anonymized findings.
Data handling: All audio is collected with participant consent. Personally identifying information will be removed prior to upload; we will provide the IRB approval letter (attached) and the lab data handling checklist.
Extension requested: 30-day trial extension starting Nov 10, 2025.
Credits requested: $2,000 in Redwood promotional credits, redeemable against hosted API (not transferable).
Start/end: Nov 10, 2025 — Dec 10, 2025.
Primary contact: Dr. Lina Mendez, pilot@andeslab.org

Please let me know if this wording works and where to sign. We appreciate the support — it will make a real difference for a small university lab with limited compute funds.

Best regards,
Lina

Attachments: IRB-approval-stub.pdf
